title: Red Hat security advisory (AV26-1163)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1163 Date: November 16, 2026 As of November 13, 2026, Red Hat is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 6 / 7 / 10 All versions Red Hat Hardened Images All versions Red Hat OpenShift Dev Spaces All versions Red Hat Satellite 6.16 for RHEL 8 / 9 Multiple versions Red Hat Satellite 6.17 for RHEL 9 Multiple versions Red Hat Satellite 6.18 for RHEL 9 Multiple versions Red Hat Satellite 6.19 for RHEL 9 Multiple versions Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4 All versions Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 5 All versions pappl-retrofit Prior to 1.0b2 Red Hat Quay 5 All versions mirror registry for Red Hat OpenShift 2 All versions quay Multiple versions The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web link and apply any necessary updates as they become available. Red Hat Security Advisories Article Link: Red Hat security advisory (AV26-1163) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
